notes_for_editor: Thin: a Forest Lookouts index entry with no detail, and a TopoQuest place record with only coordinates and elevation. No build date, use, height, staffing or current status found. The story runs about 100 words; the sources say no more, so it stays short. Coordinates in the record match TopoQuest exactly. Photo search found nothing. The Post and Courier article is undated; its 1993 link to the statewide closures comes from one sentence about a lookout job loss, so the story says the article links them.
